statements.lead: Reported by the South Wales Echo, 12 May 1988:
statements.quote: CARDIFF MP Alun Michael has asked the Lord Chancellor to look at the case of defiant farmer Bill Buckler
statements.source_title: South Wales Echo, 12 May 1988 (Legal Wiki EV-0092)

statements.lead: A BP spokesman in London, to the press, April 1988:
statements.quote: When Mrs Buckler died in 1983 it became clear her son was not going to leave
statements.source_title: Press cutting, c. 30 Apr 1988 (Legal Wiki EV-0089)

statements.lead: A Cadw spokeswoman, to the South Wales Echo, 3 December 1988:
statements.quote: An inspector has been taken off another case to look at this and we are trying to move as quickly as possible.
statements.source_title: South Wales Echo, 3 Dec 1988 (Legal Wiki EV-0103)

statements.lead: Reported by the Western Mail, 6 December 1988:
statements.quote: A spokesperson there told the Western Mail the house was not of sufficient architectural merit and the land on which it stands was not of sufficient archaeological interest.
statements.source_title: Western Mail, 6 Dec 1988 (Legal Wiki EV-0105)

statements.lead: Court of Appeal judgment, 31 July 1987:
statements.quote: This appeal, by the defendant in the action against a decision of Hollis J given on July 24 1986 when he was sitting as a judge of the Queen's Bench Division in Cardiff, raises a novel question of some potential importance under the provisions of the Limitation Acts 1939 and 1980 in relation to the acquisition of title to land by adverse possession.
statements.source_title: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2 (BAILII)

statements.lead: Court of Appeal judgment, 31 July 1987:
statements.quote: No such documents were, however, ever produced.
statements.source_title: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2 (BAILII)

statements.lead: Court of Appeal judgment, 31 July 1987:
statements.quote: I can see no escape therefore from the conclusion that, whether she liked it or not, from the time of her receipt of the letters, Mrs Buckler was in possession of the farmhouse and garden by the licence of BP Properties Ltd, and her possession was no longer adverse within the meaning of section 10 of the 1939 Act. Accordingly I would dismiss this appeal.
statements.source_title: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2 (BAILII)

statements.lead: Decision on application 14464/88, 14 April 1989:
statements.quote: Application declared inadmissible: the fair-trial complaint was not substantiated; the loss of the home was lawful and justified to protect the owner’s rights; there was no “possession” in law because the courts held the property belonged to another.
statements.source_title: Legal Wiki EV-0122 and the case page

statements.lead: GGAT to the council, 27 July 1992 (planning file 92/00671):
statements.quote: demonstrated conclusively that significant archaeological deposits exist within the proposed development area … including a quantity of human bone
statements.source_title: Planning file 92/00671, archaeology responses p.4 (Legal Wiki EV-0900)

statements.lead: GGAT to the council, 13 and 15 December 1993:
statements.quote: has not been fulfilled and cannot be discharged by your Authority
statements.source_title: Planning file 92/00671, archaeology responses pp.1–2 (Legal Wiki EV-0900)

statements.lead: GGAT to the council, on condition 18, December 1993:
statements.quote: a Breach of Condition notice is issued immediately
statements.source_title: Planning file 92/00671, archaeology responses pp.1–2 (Legal Wiki EV-0900)

statements.lead: GGAT to the council, 18 May 1994:
statements.quote: spot scheduling this rare and important site of national significance
statements.source_title: Planning file 92/00671, archaeology responses pp.38–40 (Legal Wiki EV-0900)

statements.lead: High Court at Cardiff, 24 July 1986, as reported by the South Wales Echo next day:
statements.quote: Mr [Justice] Hollis gave Mr Bill Buckler[’s] family six [weeks] to vacate Great [House] Farm Llandough after ruling [a] 10-acre block [belonged] to British Petroleum Properties Ltd
statements.source_title: South Wales Echo, 25 Jul 1986, p.3 (Legal Wiki EV-0075)

statements.lead: House of Lords, 3 March 1988:
statements.quote: Leave to appeal refused; execution stayed for 28 days.
statements.source_title: Legal Wiki, BP Properties Ltd v Buckler

statements.lead: The developer’s agent to the council, 4 February 1994, citing counsel’s opinion that condition 18:
statements.quote: has been discharged and that the approval of the detailed plans and the notice issued by your council are decisive as to that
statements.source_title: Planning file 92/00671, archaeology responses pp.24–25 (Legal Wiki EV-0900)

statements.lead: Cardiff, 5 December 1988, as reported by the Western Mail next day:
statements.quote: It would be novel for a court in this country to grant an injunction to hold up the effects of a judgment until the Court of Human Rights should rule on it, said the judge.
statements.source_title: Western Mail, 6 Dec 1988 (Legal Wiki EV-0105)

statements.lead: At the council and committee meetings of 1987 (minutes):
statements.quote: RIGHT OF WAY FROM GREAT HOUSE FARM TO THE SWISS COTTAGES … there is no justification for the right of way being submitted … no further action.
statements.source_title: Llandough Community Council minutes, 1987 (Legal Wiki EV-0214)

statements.lead: At the council meetings of 1987 (minutes):
statements.quote: Debenham Tewson, the agents for BP Properties
statements.source_title: Llandough Community Council minutes, 1987 (Legal Wiki EV-0214)

statements.lead: Reported by the South Wales Echo, 23 February 1990:
statements.quote: No objection has been made by Llandough Community Council but they [… want?] the land registered as village green
statements.source_title: South Wales Echo, 23 Feb 1990, p.1 (Legal Wiki EV-0273)

statements.lead: To the Western Mail, 20 November 1958:
statements.quote: This is a Welsh case of Crichel Down.
statements.source_title: Western Mail, 20 Nov 1958, p.7 (Legal Wiki EV-0037)

statements.lead: To The Daily Telegraph, 16 April 1974:
statements.quote: But I will refuse to move because not only is this my home it is part of the nation’s heritage
statements.source_title: The Daily Telegraph, 16 Apr 1974 (Legal Wiki EV-0048)

statements.lead: To The Daily Telegraph, 16 April 1974:
statements.quote: The ownership of the house has been in dispute for 25 years but my family has lived here for more than 400 years
statements.source_title: The Daily Telegraph, 16 Apr 1974 (Legal Wiki EV-0048)

statements.lead: Court of Appeal, 31 July 1987 (the published report):
statements.quote: MUSTILL LJ and SIR EDWARD EVELEIGH agreed and did not add anything.
statements.source_title: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2 (BAILII)

statements.lead: Court of Appeal, 31 July 1987 (the published report):
statements.quote: MUSTILL LJ and SIR EDWARD EVELEIGH agreed and did not add anything.
statements.source_title: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2 (BAILII)

statements.lead: In the House of Commons, 22 May 1980:
statements.quote: the most rapacious ground landlord, Western Ground Rents, has been bought by the BP pension fund, which is behaving in the same rapacious and, at times, unfeeling and uncaring way in handling the genuine requests of householders.
statements.source_title: Hansard, HC Deb 22 May 1980, vol. 985 (Legal Wiki EV-0057)

statements.lead: Court of Appeal order, 31 July 1987 (the published report):
statements.quote: The appeal was dismissed and possession ordered in six weeks.
statements.source_title: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2 (BAILII)

statements.lead: Outline permission 89/01396/OUT, 13 March 1990, condition:
statements.quote: no development shall take place until a field evaluation survey and archaeological assessment report has been carried out by a qualified archaeologist to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
statements.source_title: Vale of Glamorgan planning register; Legal Wiki EV-0900

statements.lead: To the press after the eviction attempt of 29 April 1988:
statements.quote: I am here to stay and I will fight this to the death.
statements.source_title: Press cutting, c. 30 Apr 1988 (Legal Wiki EV-0089)

statements.lead: To the press after the eviction attempt of 29 April 1988:
statements.quote: They have got no documents for it. If it’s theirs, why have I never paid a penny in rent for it in my life?
statements.source_title: Press cutting, c. 30 Apr 1988 (Legal Wiki EV-0089)

statements.lead: To the South Wales Echo, 13 December 1988:
statements.quote: All I’ve got left are the clothes [I] stand up in.
statements.source_title: South Wales Echo, 13 Dec 1988 (Legal Wiki EV-0110)

statements.lead: To the South Wales Echo, 24 March 1989:
statements.quote: I will fight on to the death.
statements.source_title: South Wales Echo, 24 Mar 1989 (Legal Wiki EV-0121)

statements.lead: To the South Wales Echo, 1989:
statements.quote: They have taken everything from me and my family. I have lost my livelihood.
statements.source_title: South Wales Echo, 1989 (Legal Wiki EV-0112)
